## Gráfico de la FDP y FDA de una distribución Exponencial
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 7
#| warning: false

par(
  mfrow = c(1,2),
  mar = c(5,5,3,1),
  bg = "white",
  family = "sans"
)

# Secuencia de valores
x <- seq(0, 5, length = 500)

# Colores
col1 <- "#1f4e79"
col2 <- "#2e7d32"
col3 <- "#b23a48"

# =========================
# FDP
# =========================
plot(
  x, dexp(x,1),
  type = "l",
  lwd = 4,
  col = col1,
  ylim = c(0,2.2),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "f(x)",
  main = "Función de densidad exponencial",
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85", lty = 1)

lines(x, dexp(x,0.5), lwd = 4, col = col2)
lines(x, dexp(x,2),   lwd = 4, col = col3)

legend(
  "topright",
  legend = c(expression(lambda==1),
             expression(lambda==0.5),
             expression(lambda==2)),
  col = c(col1, col2, col3),
  lwd = 4,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1
)

# =========================
# FDA
# =========================
plot(
  x, pexp(x,1),
  type = "l",
  lwd = 4,
  col = col1,
  ylim = c(0,1.05),
  xlab = "x",
  ylab = "F(x)",
  main = "Función de distribución acumulada",
  cex.main = 1.5,
  cex.lab = 1.3,
  cex.axis = 1.1
)

grid(col = "gray85", lty = 1)

lines(x, pexp(x,0.5), lwd = 4, col = col2)
lines(x, pexp(x,2),   lwd = 4, col = col3)

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c(expression(lambda==1),
             expression(lambda==0.5),
             expression(lambda==2)),
  col = c(col1, col2, col3),
  lwd = 4,
  bty = "n",
  cex = 1.1
)

```
